fix.r2: Offer a group at another time (Open seats board); consider an evening or weekend group.
fix.r3: Offer the online format or a nearer branch.
fix.r4: Talk to the teacher and observe a lesson; offer a move to another teacher.
fix.r5: Send parents a monthly progress report; agree on a mid-term test and a goal.
fix.r6: Study the competitor's price and programme; run a short survey with leavers.
fix.r7: Offer a freeze instead of leaving — the student comes back.
fix.r8: Read the notes and add any recurring reason as its own type.
